quest.title: Strange Sights, Stolen Souls
quest.description: Katheryne of the Adventurers' Guild in Liyue Harbor has a new commission for you. You and Paimon decide to find out what it's all about.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x24100, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Go to the Liyue Adventurers' Guild and talk to Katheryne

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi Katheryne, it's us! Any new commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, there's one that looks perfect for you two.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Uncle Dai is one of the foremen at Huishan Hall over in Liyue Harbor. He's hoping the Adventurers' Guild can spare some manpower.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is it we have to do exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I believe you'll be looking for workers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, looking for people? Awesome, we're good at that!

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I have no reason to doubt your abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: I'm sure the details can be worked out face to face. If you're willing to accept this commission, head over to the dock and talk to Uncle Dai.

talks.objective: Head to the dock and find the foreman, Uncle Dai
Head to the dock and find the foreman, Uncle Dai

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Are you Uncle Dai?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: I am indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Ahh, now then, you must be the adventurers assigned by the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How could you tell!?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: By the clothes on your back and the look on your face. Experienced adventurers at that, I'll wager.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right again! You're pretty perceptive!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Hahaha. In this trade, you need a sharp eye for people, not just rocks. Uncle Dai can see what you're made of from a long way off.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Alright, my assistant should be arriving soon so let's just wait here a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa whoa, that's why we're here! Now there's someone else taking a cut?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Well, to tell you the truth, this is a very difficult matter. Too much for adventurers alone to handle, I fear...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! So there is someone else!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you think we're not up to the job?

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: It just occurred to me that you don't have all the facts. The incident in question happened in a mine, and it's a little out of the ordinary, to say the least. Mines are dangerous places, as I'm sure you're aware. As such, I've enlisted an industry expert to cover all contingencies.

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: Last time I checked, adventurers weren't experts in ore appraisal or geological analysis. With a professional by your side, everything should run smoothly.

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: Besides, this guy is the best in his field. No matter the rock, he'll tell you its value to the nearest Mora at a glance.

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: I'd go as far to say that there's not a soul in Teyvat that knows rocks better than him. I'd be a fool to not enlist an expert of his caliber!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're a fool if you think you found Teyvat's number one rock expert!

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: Oh? And why might that be?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Because Teyvat's number one rock expert happens to be a friend of ours...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You must be talking about...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Perfect, I was planning to ask him a few questions.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haha~ Didn't expect that, did you! Wait here, we'll go fetch him.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Tongue Tian
dialogues.text: In our last tale, Rex Lapis...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zhongli! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Oh!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Here for a few tales? I didn't know you two were connoisseurs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no no! We're here for you! Um... do you have time?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah... something I'm rarely short of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We need someone who understands geology and ore.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hmm... someone who understands geology and ore...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Take a look around! Is there anyone in Teyvat more qualified?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The requester claims to have enlisted Teyvat's number one rock expert, but Paimon doesn't believe a word of it. Nobody understands rocks better than you!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: You appear to have taken his claim quite personally on my behalf.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, no no... it's just... Uncle Dai doesn't know what he's talking about!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon just wants to... enlighten him...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Hahaha, I see. Well then, it will be my pleasure to accompany you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really!?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: But I should inform you that despite my expertise... I cannot necessarily claim to be a leading authority.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: We are at all times adrift in a sea of learning — new knowledge should be welcomed with open arms. Still, I imagine I will be of help to you in this endeavor. If we do encounter an expert, I look forward to broadening my own understandings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... stop being so modest, Zhongli.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we got him! Let's head back to Uncle Dai!

talks.objective: Return to the dock and talk to Uncle Dai

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uncle Dai! We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Oh! And this must be the friend you spoke of?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Paimon doesn't know who your rock expert is, but he's got nothing on our guy!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Haha, let's not get ahead of ourselves. Still, I do have a claim to some experience in this field.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, so you say. Wait till my guy gets here, then we'll see.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: It's no use me singing his praises. You'll have to see for yourselves.
Uh... is this the place?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Aha! Speak of the devil! Allow me to introduce my assistant, Kun Jun.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Young Kun, these are two adventurers assigned to us. And as for this gentleman...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is Zhongli, a consultant from the funeral parlor.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor's consultant... Mr. Zhongli! I've heard about you. They say you're a man of great knowledge and many talents. I had no idea I'd be meeting you in person today.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: I... I'm sure I recognize you... Have we met at the parlor? Wait, I've never been to the parlor...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uncle Dai, aren't you going to test them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that's what you were planning.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Huh? I... I wouldn't know where to start...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then they can figure out a way to test each other! If Zhongli wins, he's the assistant. If Zhongli loses, uh... N—Never mind, Zhongli won't lose!

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: A contest? Why, it would be my pleasure!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I admire your enthusiasm, good sir.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Haha! I must say, you certainly have the look of an industry expert about you. It'll be interesting to see which one of us wins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stop talking the talk and start walking the walk!

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: I'm just saying it like I see it, haha... Which is incidentally the only skill I have worth talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: So you're an appraiser, Mr. Kun Jun?

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Well, no... actually I've already forgotten what I'm in Liyue Harbor for... I was standing by the side of the road one day when Uncle Dai called me over.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: He saw me holding a rock and asked me a few questions. He seemed incredibly excited, even followed me for a while. We arranged to meet here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How could you forget something like that?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: I saw him on my way over to Liyue Harbor, poring over rocks and muttering to himself. He looked to be very familiar with them.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: I asked him a few questions out of curiosity. To my surprise, he knew more than me, an old mining foreman! In any case, he didn't have any pressing matters, and agreed to help me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... do you have a poor memory?

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Not exactly... Anyway, if it's rocks you need help with, I can most certainly lend a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhongli, what do you make of this rock?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A glossy exterior, with a fissure that could only have been left in the wake of a volcanic eruption. If I'm not mistaken, this is a rough gem from another nation.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Ah... a keen eye!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It's no ordinary rough gem. Fragile surface layer, black veining... My intuition tells me that there's high-quality crystal ore inside.

dialogues.speaker: Kun Jun
dialogues.text: Remarkable. This rock does indeed hail from the vicinity of a volcano. I came across it in a market and snapped it straight up. The seller thought it was some leftover industrial remnant. They had no inkling of the treasure that lay within.

response.speaker: Kun Jun
response.text: Purity and geological rarity alone aren't enough to make a treasure. Some of the most precious crystals contain deposits of water or sand.

response.speaker: Kun Jun
response.text: In the moment of its formation, the crystal hidden within this stone shell captured a pocket of water. For water to be hidden in its depths, like a moon concealed within a mountain, reflecting shafts of daylight that make it through... Now that's a rare treasure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Such a detailed description, almost like he saw it with his own two eyes...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Say... you're not trying to hoodwink us are you? After all, we haven't even seen what's inside yet!

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Everything he said is true.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Most crystals are born in high-temperature environments. Heat and water aren't natural bedfellows of course, which is why crystals with water deposits are so sought-after. Moreover, this particular crystal contains mountain lake water. A rare find indeed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well if Zhongli says so, it must be true...

response.speaker: Kun Jun
response.text: I've yet to encounter anyone with a judgment as shrewd as yours, Mr. Zhongli. How did you know exactly what lay within?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: I've seen many such stones in my time, I recognized it immediately. I hope you didn't mind me flaunting my experience, Mr. Kun Jun?

response.speaker: Kun Jun
response.text: Of course not! I feel I've met a kindred spirit here today. I hope you will accept my friendship.

response.speaker: Kun Jun
response.text: Uncle Dai, it would be a mistake for Mr. Zhongli not to join us! Trust me when I say that his level of expertise is unrivaled in the trade. You won't come across another of his caliber in your lifetime.

response.speaker: Uncle Dai
response.text: Very well, there is strength in numbers after all! Everyone, follow me to The Chasm. There are men counting on you to find them.

choices.text: What makes this one so special?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Dai
dialogues.text: Your rock expert... what does he look like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon bets Zhongli is listening to the Storyteller. Let's head over!
